metadata.name: project-iam

variables.name: condition_description
variables.example: Temporary access for the Q4 migration

metadata.description: Grants one IAM role to one principal on a project (additive, never removes existing access).

variables.name: project_id
variables.description: ID of the GCP project the role is granted on. 6-30 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen.

validations.error_message: project_id must be 6-30 characters of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, start with a letter and not end with a hyphen.

variables.name: member
variables.description: Principal that receives the role, with its type prefix: user:alice@example.com, group:devs@example.com, serviceAccount:<sa>@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com, domain:example.com, or a principal:// / principalSet:// workload identity. allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers are rejected.

validations.error_message: member must be a user:, group:, serviceAccount:, domain: or principal(Set):// principal; allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers are not allowed.

variables.name: role
variables.description: Role to grant: a predefined role such as roles/compute.viewer, or a custom role as projects/<project>/roles/<id> or organizations/<org-id>/roles/<id>. roles/owner and roles/editor are rejected unless allow_privileged_roles is true.

validations.error_message:
role must be a predefined (roles/...) or custom (projects/

/roles/... or organizations//roles/...) role name.
roles/owner and roles/editor violate least privilege; grant a narrower role or set allow_privileged_roles = true.

variables.name: condition_title
variables.description: Title of an optional IAM Condition that limits when the grant applies, for example temporary-access-until-2026-12-31 (max 100 characters). Leave empty for an unconditional grant; set it together with condition_expression.

validations.error_message: condition_title must be 1-100 characters and not blank.

variables.name: condition_expression
variables.description: CEL expression of the IAM Condition, for example request.time < timestamp("2026-12-31T00:00:00Z"). Required when condition_title is set; leave empty otherwise.

validations.error_message: condition_title and condition_expression must be set together (or both left empty).

variables.name: condition_description
variables.description: Optional free-text description of the IAM Condition, for example Temporary access for the Q4 migration. Only used when condition_title is set.

validations.error_message: condition_description needs condition_title and condition_expression to be set.

variables.name: allow_privileged_roles
variables.description: Allow granting the basic roles/owner or roles/editor roles. Leave false unless a break-glass grant is explicitly approved.
